intended_object: An index type made of pairs (i, U), where i is an index of the directed system and U is a compact open subset of E(i). It labels the compact-open cylinders of the inverse limit. Inferred from the docstring and from its use in `CompactOpenBasis.lean`.
explanation: The definition is a dependent sum type, Σ i, {U : Opens (E i) // IsCompact U}. It does nothing but index the cylinder sets π_i⁻¹(U) on the limit; the next declaration in the same file uses it to build those cylinders. It is bookkeeping for the proof that compact-open cylinders form a basis of the limit, so it is not a standard mathematical object in its own right. The construction itself is what the docstring says.
